title: The Notebook With No Spine
skyStory: Still in Gemini, the moon has dropped to eighty-two percent and is busy reorganising its bookshelf by mood rather than alphabet. Every star has a new idea and wants to tell you about it. Saturn has installed a suggestion box and it is overflowing. Mars wrote suggestion number forty in capital letters. It says MORE.

reading: Ten things want your attention today, and Gemini is cheering for all ten. The Tiger knows better. Write the ten on a page, cross out seven, circle one and leave two as backup dancers. The [[Knight of Wands]] reversed hates that list, so it must be right.

Around 2:40 pm you will find a notebook you started and abandoned, full of good ideas. Do not start it again. Read one page, smile at past-you and close it. Some ideas were only meant to keep you company for a while. That is enough.
joel.mission: Write ten tasks, cross out seven, circle one. Do only the circled one today. The other two may wait politely.
joel.omen: A half-finished crossword left on a table. It means a puzzle is meant to stay unfinished; let it go.

reading: The overheard thing from yesterday is still in your pocket. Today it starts to make sense, a clue in a mystery only you are solving. The Wood Rat loves a case. Turn it over a few times and watch where it fits.

Gemini brings two invitations today. You only need to say yes to one. The other is happy to wait for spring. Choose the one that makes your shoulders drop, not the one that makes your to-do list longer. Saturn, your ruler, says rest is also a form of levelling up.
nancy.mission: Say a gracious no or not yet to one invitation today. Notice how much lighter the evening feels.
nancy.omen: A bench with a single glove on it. It means something lost is about to be found; check a coat pocket.

together.text: Trade one not-doing each for this week, declared out loud to the other. Declaring the not-doing is half the fun. Gemini will try to talk you out of it with very convincing hand puppets. Do not let Gemini win.

game.intro: A notebook with no spine has applied for a job. Give it a purpose, then guess which one the other picked.
game.question: A notebook with no spine needs a job. What should it hold?
